record.question: Which of the following is a salient feature of the Indian Pharmacopoeia?
options: The book is intended for use by physicians to help them decide their p-drug on a case-based scenario.
The main focus is on drugs of plant origin and their regulations.
The main target is drug manufacturers as the book provides legal standards for drugs manufactured in India.
The main focus is on the production of various dosage forms from a single drug to help drug manufacturers decide their options.
record.explanation: Answer C: The main target is drug manufacturers as the book provides legal standards for drugs manufactured in India.. The Indian Pharmacopoeia establishes legally recognized quality standards for drugs manufactured/imported in India and is used by manufacturers, regulators, and laboratories. Reference: https://ipc.gov.in/mandates/indian-pharmacopoeia.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
